description: Search the Find My Farmer registry of local farms in Canada. Returns farm name, location (city/province), type, and the canonical findmyfarmer.ca page URL. Search matches farm names, stories, and what each farm sells (goods, packages, events).

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. "beef", "sourdough", "farm stays". Omit to list farms.

name: search_farms
